I have only 0.12 hectares for this sorghum plot, so I must make the most of it. I will apply some DAP and urea from the cooperative if it arrives on time, and I have manure from my livestock to mix in. For seed, I will use what I saved from last year's harvest since improved sorghum seed is hard to find here. I will rely on my family to work this small plot—we cannot afford to hire labor, and the rains should be enough without irrigation.
